prompt_md: Which number, spelled out in English, has exactly as many letters as its value?
prompt_short: Which number has as many letters as its value?
hint_md: Count on your fingers: one, two, three...
explain_intuition_md: Five has four letters and three has five, so they feel close, but only four matches itself: f-o-u-r is exactly 4 letters.
explain_math_md: Letter counts: one 3, two 3, three 5, four 4, five 4, six 3. Past four the value outruns the letters for good.
